title: Boring
body: For an app that says it’s “not boring” it’s very boring it’s the same plain 3d design the whole time and i tried this app but I got absolutely no motivation for anything. Make this app more colourful make it actually entertaining and motivational like rewards to do tasks.
author: Ezzzziieee

title: Fantastic habit tracker
body: I’m not one to write reviews as I honestly can’t be bothered most of the time unless I’m writing to complain but this app is significantly better than most. It’s minimalistic yet still interactive. I’m not interested in the invasiveness of other habit trackers that seem too overwhelming and bombard you with sometimes unattainable goal suggestions that just seem unrealistic. I seem to lose interest in many of the other habit tracker apps pretty quickly because they all seem to be the same generic dynamic but this one is quite unique and fun. The options to varying notification settings and the different sculptures that you can complete by achieving your goals/habits is a fantastic idea to keep the consumer captivated. I have recommended this app to many of my friends and they find it great. Kudos to the developers.
author: NxHarvey

title: Please please please give me the soundscapes or upload a playlist to Spotify!!
body: The music is absolutely gorgeous, please upload it to Spotify or make it available in the app as a soundscape mode
author: ChristopherMWhite

title: Best tracker app I’ve used
body: I purchased the S2 for the weather app, but Habits is really the star for me. It’s helped me build up my exercise habit so well. 2 things stand out - first, the monthly calendar widget; second, the calendar year view. Animations are delightful, and the haptics and animation on the button are awesome. The app’s simplicity makes it that much amazing to use. Feature request: it would be awesome to add a personal note against an occurrence of a habit, when you mark as complete. Maybe not a main feature, but something in the background.
author: Plastictosh

title: Pretty!
body: I love this app, it’s really helpful for getting better at keeping habits!
author: _SKYLINE_

title: Too basic
body:
Lovely designed app that sadly is a bit too basic to track diverse habits. Lack of sync to heath app for fitness tracking and lack of weekly goals (instead of daily) is what makes this too bare bones to recommend or use. 

If you have things you do daily then this might work for you. Hoping updates are coming.
author: dubielzyk

title: Beautiful app but the habits don’t sync
body: I like this app a lot. I agree with the premise that if something is beautiful, you want to interact with it more. The main problem I have with this app though is that I can’t get it to sync between my iPhone and iPad. Even though both have iCloud settings on, it creates a fresh install with each and doesn’t sync over any data. So I won’t end up using it or purchasing a membership unless it has the ability to sync.
author: Horabiscus

title: Great motivational writing
body: It’s easy to overlook how well written the text is in this app. The motivational phrases are encouraging but never guilt inducing. And the progression over 60 days of habit formation feels real in how the text shifts toward achieving the goal. It forms an excellent part of the overall vibe of this beautifully produced app.
author: byrninator

title: Weird mixture of awesome and terrible
body:
There are some amazing things about this app - the concept of getting to 60 and getting up the levels is really motivating, plus the animations and retro game vibes are awesome. 

But aside from that, the interface is so hard to use that I had to delete the app. I wanted to love it but I can’t stand it. Nothing works conventionally, even ordinary stuff. I can barely figure out how to do anything. I can’t seem to see all my habits at once? The free themes are either gloomy black or obnoxious industrial yellow and you have to pay a crazy amount for other themes. The contrast is so low on those default themes that I can barely see what stuff is. 

This app is a very cool swing at a better habit tracking experience but because the overall usability is terrible, it ends up being a total miss.
author: jul_k
